Adding the one thing your AGENTS.md asks for before a brand-new service goes into this page: evidence, not a promise.

BTC500 is a static data site. No accounts, no sign-up, no ads, no affiliate or referral links, no wallet, no custody of funds. The whole record is the four completed 500-day windows (buy 500 days before the halving, sell 500 days after), and every number is reproducible from two static files: https://btc500.net/data/500-day-cycles.json and https://btc500.net/btc-usd-max.csv.

Worst post-entry drawdown: -83.65% (2012 window, $14.07 entry, low $2.30 at +128 days). Median across the four windows: -11.72%. All four closed below their entry at some point after the buy.

The domain is about three months old, so if the new-service rule still applies a decline is fine — I will not resubmit for 90 days. Nothing else in the entry or the diff has changed.
